captions.detailed: This 3D model is a 3D-printable chainmail bracelet designed to be printed as a single, flexible assembly. It consists of a long, repeating band of interlocking rectangular links oriented at opposing 40-degree angles, creating a textured chevron or herringbone pattern. Each end of the band features a integrated flat rectangular clasp segment designed to interconnect and secure the bracelet around a wrist.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric, 3D-printable chainmail bracelet in OpenSCAD. The user should be able to customize the total length, width (number of links), ring thickness, and spacing, with interlocking angled links and matching end clasps.
captions.factory: The script defines the bracelet using modular components: 'link', 'half_link', 'band', and 'clasp'. The 'link' and 'half_link' modules are created using a base cube rotated by -40 degrees, from which internal rectangular holes and outer flat boundaries are subtracted using the difference operator. The 'band' module uses nested for-loops to arrange these links in alternating right-leaning and left-leaning orientations. Finally, the 'clasp' module uses cubes and linear extrusions of custom polygons to form the interlocking end connectors.
